desc: The Exchange has received the disclosure under Regulation 29(1) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 for Algoquant Fintech Ltd

The Registrar of Companies, Delhi has granted extension of Three (3) months i.e. upto December 30, 2026 to hold the Annual General Meeting of the Shareholders of the Company, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 29(1) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, we wish to inform you that the Company has received information from Algoquant Fintech Limited in relation to the acquisition of shares of the company. Upon review, the details provided by Algoquant Fintech Limited do not appear to be in line with the shareholding records available with the Company. Accordingly, the Company has sought the requisite clarification from Algoquant Fintech Limited in the regards. As on date Company is awaiting the requisite clarification and supporting information from Algoquant Fintech Limited. Upon receipt of the Correct and complete information, the company shall duly verify and reconcile the same with its records and undertake necessary compliance/action in accordance with the applicable provisions of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.

Pursuant to Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for the Quarter, Half year and year ended on March 31, 2026 and the Quarter ended June 30, 2026 the company wants clarify that the delay has occurred due to exceptional circumstances arising from the scheme of Amalgamation sanctioned by the Hon''ble NCLT, New Delhi Bench, Court-II, vide order dated April 17, 2026, whereby five wholly owned subsidiaries of the company were amalgamated with the company with an Appointed date of April 1, 2022. Consequent to the amalgamation time has been required for necessary accounting adjustment, reconciliation and finalisation for year ended March 31, 2026 resulting delay in finalising the financial results of the quarter ended June 30 2026. Company is taking all possible efforts to complete it at the earliest and the delay is purely attributable to the aforesaid exceptional circumstances and is neither wilful nor intentional. Company is committed to transparent disclosure and timely compliance

Vipul Ltd - 511726 - Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India 
(Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
